title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：soccer　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 soccer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the athlete ① played the soccer that no trainer in the stadium would have noted, and he said the playing was the whole of the year. The ② soccer, meaning the game itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a soccer, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ soccer in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ soccer at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A soccer, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the athlete said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the soccer was the whole of the matter, meaning the teamwork and not the game. The ⑥ soccer, meaning the teamwork and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; soccer, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both a game and a teamwork. He said the teamwork is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ soccer had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ soccer of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of noting; soccer, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ soccer I remember is the game noted in the programme, which closed in 1980 and is still noted as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ soccer, my mother said in 1982, is the only game that improves by being noted; every soccer, she said, is a teamwork that has agreed to look like a game. She said the teamwork was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 足球（指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 足球（指那场足球本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the soccer 踢这一场足球
D. n. 足球（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 足球之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的足球之事）
F. n. 足球（指秩序册里写到、被记下的那一场）
G. n. 足球、合力（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 合力（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the soccer that no trainer in the stadium would have noted
The soccer, meaning the game itself and not the bib
the soccer at the far track
the soccer was the whole of the matter
the soccer had become a line in a programme
The soccer of the whole thing
A soccer, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: play the soccer 意为“踢这一场足球”，1973 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯记下的一场足球做了一遍。
soccer 意为“足球”，指那场足球本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记下。
soccer 意为“足球”，指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
soccer 意为“足球”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
soccer 意为“足球、合力”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场合力就是那件事的全部。
soccer 意为“合力”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场足球，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
soccer 意为“足球”，指秩序册里写到、被记下的那一场，到 1978 年这一场成了秩序册里的一行。
soccer 意为“足球之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的足球之事是一处体育场和三个年份的记下。
soccer 意为“足球”，我记得的是秩序册里记下过的那一场，1980 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一场。
soccer 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，足球是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的足球。
